WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) as avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as overall_avg_rate_per_duration
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_replacement_cost,
  rs.avg_rate_per_duration,
  rs.avg_rate_per_duration / oa.overall_avg_rate_per_duration as ratio
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY rs.rating
